claim_boundary: Task-grader qualification only; not a model or agent result, capability result, fresh task exposure to a model, or learning authorization.
dependency_note: Use the existing digest-pinned MLX CPU image with synthetic inputs and pinned mlx-lm source; no pytest, model weights, datasets, network, or new downloads. The grader calls only the task adapter and keeps expected results in the parent.

exposure.audit_scope: 146 retained VARE refs and 5,796 local VARE evidence files under model/agent artifact paths; exact task identifiers and explicit SSM padding/right-padding descriptions searched. External model pretraining remains unknown. A first broad-pattern scan found an adjacent #1978 task; manual review confirmed its model prompt only named RotatingKVCache in cache.py, did not mention SSM/padding, did not edit source, and ran no tests. The initial false-positive scan is preserved separately.

purpose: Qualify one additional original held-out task with immutable source/test/prompt identity, an audited VARE exposure search, a source-only sandbox, and bounded parent-owned semantic checks. This does not change the frozen split and is not model or agent evidence.
qualification_gate: Pinned source, grader, prompt and license hashes match; baseline fails; exact target-only known fix passes; prespecified incorrect mutant fails; unsafe patch controls reject before execution; common no-network/grader-separation boundary passes.

runtime.candidate_visible_files: Only Python source under pinned mlx_lm plus a call adapter; no task prompt, tests, Git metadata, grader or expected values.

criteria: Task is in the original frozen held-out allocation; no task outcome was used to select it or tune a model.
Pinned source-level MLX-LM regression has a local CPU path with synthetic inputs and no model weights.
Exposure scan covers the frozen VARE refs and identified model/agent artifact paths; any match is reviewed and preserved.
No model, coding agent, or learning process receives the task prompt, fix, test source, grader values, or outcomes.

stop_criteria: Stop if any pinned source, test, prompt, license, image or exposure hash differs.
Do not install or download model/dependency assets.
Stop if the candidate can access the network or grader, if resource limits are exceeded, or if host swap grows over 256 MiB.
A task that misses any gate remains UNQUALIFIED in its original held-out split.

task_contracts.expected_assertions: For deterministic synthetic inputs and a nonzero initial state, compare valid-token outputs and returned final state from the fixed-length sequence against the same sequence with right padding and an explicit mask/length. Both comparisons use the upstream test tolerance 1e-4 absolute and relative. Require finite padded outputs and state. Hidden expected booleans are parent-owned; no exact expected tensor values or upstream test enter the candidate container.
task_contracts.incorrect_mutant: Starting from the pinned fix, replace dtA = dtA * mask[..., None] with dtA = dtA; this prevents padding from being excluded from state decay.
task_contracts.status_note: Known fix is calibration-only. No model or agent inference, update, or training is authorized by this task certificate.
